Definition: Joach, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joah is named 10 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 2 Kings 18:18; 1 Chronicles 6:21; 2 Chronicles 29:12. In 2 Kings 18:18 we read, "And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and 2 Chronicles 29:12 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Joah is on God's list, and I believe he writes down names the world would leave out. That is why I do not skip the lists: every name in them was loved.
RelatedPeople: Joah, Son of Asaph; Joah, Son of Zimmah
